text: Industrial tejföl is cream heated to 75 °C, homogenised at 100-160 bar so that it does not separate, and set with a lactic culture, either in the cup or in a tank. Fermentation temperature and time are not given by the source. The article is inconsistent on the minimum fat (10, 12 and 16 % all appear).

steps.note: Set with a lactic culture, in the cup (firm tejföl) or in the tank and then stirred (smooth, habart tejföl).

processing.text: Industrially set with a pure lactic culture, in the cup or in a tank. Traditionally the cream rose on warm milk for 2-3 days in summer, 6-7 in winter, and soured by itself.
